description: Two simultaneous production  processes for the same repository derive the same distributed Erlang node name in Hancho.State.Bedrock.ensure_distribution/1. One process fails with  and a low-level  error. Add an explicit cross-process repository state lock or another safe serialization boundary, and return a stable Hancho error instead of allowing concurrent Bedrock clusters to contend for the same local state.
title: Serialize concurrent state inspection
